articles.title: D+dd Friendship Bay Store / Sò Studio
articles.summary: D+dd occupies a compact building at the corner of a community square, surrounded by an auditorium, residential blocks and other structures from different periods. Originally used as a back-of-house support space, the building has long been embedded in the everyday life of the neighbourhood, where pedestrian movement, social interactions and community activities continuously overlap. When Sò Studio began the renovation, the site already carried a distinct spatial identity shaped by years of use.

articles.title: Lomadas House / Grizzo Studio
articles.summary: Casa Lomadas is set on a double plot opening onto more than one hundred meters of lagoon shoreline. The project is defined by a precise morphological operation: a folded bar of exposed concrete rests on two mounds of native vegetation, configuring a system in which architecture and landscape are fully integrated.

articles.title: Mel House / Francisco Lang Arquitetura
articles.summary: Located in the municipality of Cavalcante, in the heart of the Chapada dos Veadeiros, amidst the preserved Cerrado and with views of the Santana mountain range, Casa da Mel was conceived during the pregnancy of the architect's daughter. The project was built to welcome the family with Mel's arrival.

articles.title: 23 Living / Plan:b arquitectos
articles.summary: This commission consisted of the design of a residential building on a long plot with a steep slope. The Provenza neighborhood, located on the eastern hillside of the city of Medellín , features an irregular urban grid, partly shaped by the sloping topography. In this context, we proposed that the new building incorporate a stepped public path on its southern side, crossing the block and shortening the pedestrian route.

articles.title: Santo Antonio Apartment / Balaio Arquitetura
articles.summary: The reasons for choosing an apartment are diverse and revolve around what can and cannot be transformed. Location, room dimensions, natural light, and existing spatial layouts require an eye on the present, but also on the potential that the future holds.

articles.title: Curtain House / Johnsen Schmaling Architects
articles.summary: The Curtain House is a private residence on a long, vacant, narrow parcel embedded in Milwaukee's Lower East Side, a dense demographically diverse neighborhood known for affordable housing options and its lively mix of young families, blue-collar workers, students and artists. The clients, lifelong urban dwellers looking for a buildable lot in the central city to build their first home, acquired the 24'-wide infill property directly from the Milwaukee Department of City Development, which had taken ownership of it two decades earlier after condemning and razing an abandoned house there.

articles.title: DreamDomes' Elegant, Weather-Resistant Dome-Shaped Event Tents
articles.summary: This elegant Crossover L event tent is by DreamDomes , a UK-based event-structure company. Unlike a pole tent, it requires no central support, and provides uninterrupted floor space. Additionally, the dome shape does a better job handling wind. The diameter is roughly 30 feet, the entry sides are 8 feet and change at their highest point, and the airy ceiling maxes out around 16 feet. The company says it will comfortably fit 60 people. articles.title: Michael Hilgers' Multifunctional Side Table
articles.summary: This simple design for a multifunctional table is by Berlin-based designer Michael Hilgers. It's two pieces of powder-coated steel and serves as a side table; or, flipped over, it becomes a magazine rack. The halves can also be separated and wall-mounted through the same holes used to join them. It then serves as dual floating nightstands. The table is going into production by Purstahl, an Austrian manufacturer of steel furniture. At press time it wasn't yet on their website.
